querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      price_type_code,
                                      price_type,
                                      b_anal_nxoptiondate,
                                      b_anal_termifexercise,
                                      b_anal_ytm_ifexe,
                                      b_anal_durationifexercise,
                                      b_anal_modiduration_ifexe,
                                      b_anal_convexity_ifexe,
                                      b_anal_basevalue_ifexe,
                                      b_anal_bduration_ifexe,
                                      b_anal_bconvexity_ifexe,
                                      b_anal_sduration_ifexe,
                                      b_anal_sconvexity_ifexe,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_coptionembeddedbondvaluation.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.coptionembeddedbondvaluation WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
